children: Shares of Herc Holdings rose after the company posted higher third-quarter profit and revenue, driven by an increase in equipment rental revenue.
Shares rose 15% to $145.63, the largest intraday percentage increase since April 2025. The stock is down 1.3% year to date.
The equipment rental company in the third quarter posted a profit of $104 million, or $3.10 a share, compared with $30 million, or 90 cents a share a year earlier.
On an adjusted basis, per-share earnings were $3.91. Wall Street analysts expected $2.93.

Revenue rose 5% to $1.36 billion, compared with $1.3 billion the same time last year. Analysts polled by FactSet expected $1.35 billion. Equipment rental revenue increased 12% to $1.25 billion this quarter.
Herc raised its full-year equipment rental revenue guidance to between $4.48 billion and $4.55 billion, compared with its previous guidance of between $4.38 billion and $4.48 billion.
